summary: Security fix, update soon with piiShield: up to 0.24.2 an e-mail, IBAN or phone number right after a line break, tab or other JSON-escaped character in a tool result (also result handles, approvals, view context) could reach the model in plain text.
howTo: Nothing to change in code: update. Results without escaped characters are shielded exactly as before. A custom PiiDetector now gets real line breaks, tabs and control characters inside the JSON text instead of escape sequences (still one call per result); check a detector that relied on seeing \n as two characters. Audit positions of results with escaped characters now count real characters. Unchanged limits: object keys and numbers are not pseudonymized; keep personal data out of keys and send phone numbers as strings.
